elements.note: The finished result in the browser, edge to edge: the generated video page. A strip of desktop wallpaper shows above and below.

A pointing hand coming in from the bottom right; the fingertip (about x 60, y 46) touches the most important spot (the result's title). In TikMaker: a cut-out photo of a hand, moved with keyframes from spot to spot. The `highlight` outline is the quieter alternative.

note: A full page is too much to read in a few seconds; a finger on screen tells the viewer exactly where to look, and moving it walks them through the key spots one by one.
